h4r4_theorem_target.system_class: quasilinear first-order symmetrizable-hyperbolic two-sided interface IBVP after the H4R3 reduction
h4r4_theorem_target.boundary_class: noncharacteristic principal interface in the reduced derivative variables with maximally conservative principal subspace; exact nonlinear lower-order cap maps retained
h4r4_theorem_target.regularity_target: radial 1+1 reduction, integer Sobolev index m>=3

required_bulk_export: all coefficient derivatives needed through compatibility order m-1
exact_interface_residual_vector: patch/flux residual as a separate global-compatibility channel
required_boundary_export: B(W_N,W_S,Q_N,Q_S) exact nonlinear local interface residual
time-jet recursion for d_tau^j B at tau=0
cap source derivatives lambda, Z_sigma and winding-sector dependencies exactly frozen
global patch/flux compatibility data and pole/cap regularity data

order_zero: C_H[W_s^0]=0 and C_M[W_s^0]=0 on each side
R_patch=0 and quantized flux sector fixed
all continuity and cap regularity conditions hold
compatibility_hierarchy.recursive_rule: For j=1,...,m-1 require d_tau^j B|_{tau=0}=0 after every time derivative is recursively eliminated with the exact first-order evolution equations and exact lower-order source maps; require the corresponding differentiated constraint and patch identities to vanish to the theorem-required order.
compatibility_hierarchy.why_not_expanded_here: H4 exports the exact covariant field equations and cap residual inventory, but the repository does not yet export a single exact gauge-fixed first-order coefficient map F_s(W) and boundary-jet generator. Expanding j>=1 without that artifact would silently choose unresolved lower-order conventions and would not be auditable.

manufactured_solution_preflight.purpose: future code verification only; not a physical solution and not evidence
manufactured_solution_preflight.analytic_family: choose smooth side fields U_s^MMS(tau,x_s) with positive a, ell and finite varphi on a compact rectangle; derive P_s and Q_s analytically
manufactured_solution_preflight.constraint_forcing_policy: MMS verification may use explicit manufactured constraint-source diagnostics, but no constraint-violating manufactured run may be reinterpreted as a physical parent solution
required_tests_before_execution: symbolic or high-precision consistency of f_s^MMS and g_Sigma^MMS
predeclared convergence order p for the chosen discretization
patch/flux residual when the manufactured family exercises the gauge sector
no clipping, sign flipping, residual forcing suppression or post-hoc tolerance changes
manufactured_solution_preflight.pass_rule: observed convergence rate agrees with the predeclared formal order within a separately frozen tolerance and all boundary/constraint diagnostics converge at the declared rate
